notes.title: Get Vertical Stlice: A Game Dev Story with 35% discount
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Today, we’re happy to announce that 2P Games will be hosting its first [b]Weeklong Deals[/b] of the year [b]until Monday, March 14th[/b] (10 AM PST). In this new sales period, you'll find [b]discounts of up to 70%[/b] in all our games line-up — it’s definitely the perfect moment to get your hands on a bunch of amazing indie gems created by small promising Chinese devs!

Check here the list of discounts and click on each game to visit its Store page:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491170/Vertical_Slice_A_Game_Dev_Story/]Vertical Slice: A Game Dev Story[/url] / 35% off (only in Chinese)
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048350/Nigate_Tale/]Nigate Tale[/url] / 30% off
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1074070/Dust_to_the_End/]Dust to the End[/url] / 35% off
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1000080/Zengeon/]Zengeon[/url] / 55% off
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1078490/Seed_Hunter/]Seed Hunter[/url] / 70% off
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169690/Shadowplay_Metropolis_Foe/]ShadowPlay[/url] / 50% off (for the first time ever!)
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398740/The_Chrono_Jotter/]The Chrono Jotter[/url] / 20% discount (only in Chinese)
[/list]
Also, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/2pgames]visit our publisher hub[/url] to see the full list of games we published.

We cover different genres and themes! Give us a chance to surprise you with any of these wonderful titles and [url=https://discord.com/invite/xkPVydEfYU]join our Discord community[/url] today to discuss your game experience with the rest of our players. Our community is still small, but very welcoming.

Happy gaming!
2P Games Team
